DevicePairing.title: DevicePairing
DevicePairing.description: Represents a pairing session for a new hardware device.

pairingToken.description: A short, unique token displayed by the device for the user to enter in the app.

userId.description: The UID of the user who claimed the device. Initially null.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the pairing document was created.

MusicControlState.title: MusicControlState
MusicControlState.description: Represents the desired and reported state of the music player device.

command.description: The command sent from the app to the device.

lastCommandTimestamp.description: Timestamp of the last command sent, to avoid re-triggering.

status.description: The current status reported by the device.

currentTrack.description: The track number currently playing, reported by the device.

trackCount.description: The total number of tracks on the SD card, reported by the device.

ThresholdConfiguration.title: ThresholdConfiguration
ThresholdConfiguration.description: Represents the configuration settings for environmental stress detection, including sound, light, and temperature thresholds.

id.description: Unique identifier for the threshold configuration.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this configuration.

soundThresholdLow.description: The lower threshold for sound level, which triggers the 'Naranja' state.

soundThresholdMedium.description: The medium threshold for sound level, which triggers the 'Rojo' state.

lightThresholdLow.description: The lower threshold for light level, which triggers the 'Naranja' state.

lightThresholdMedium.description: The medium threshold for light level, which triggers the 'Rojo' state.

temperatureThresholdVerde.description: The temperature threshold (°C) above which the 'Naranja' state is triggered.

temperatureThresholdNaranja.description: The temperature threshold (°C) above which the 'Rojo' state is triggered.

orangeSoundEventCount.description: Number of sound events to trigger the orange light blockage.

redSoundEventCount.description: Number of sound events to trigger the red light blockage.

timeBetweenEvents.description: Time window (in ms) to count sound events for blockage logic.

orangeBlockDuration.description: Duration (in ms) the orange light stays blocked after sound events.

redBlockDuration.description: Duration (in ms) the red light stays blocked after sound events.

orangeLightEventCount.description: Number of light events to trigger the orange light blockage.

redLightEventCount.description: Number of light events to trigger the red light blockage.

timeBetweenLightEvents.description: Time window (in ms) to count light events for blockage logic.

orangeLightBlockDuration.description: Duration (in ms) the orange light stays blocked after light events.

redLightBlockDuration.description: Duration (in ms) the red light stays blocked after light events.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the NeuroSense Dashboard application.

SensorData.title: SensorData
SensorData.description: Represents the real-time sensor readings from the hardware device.

temperature.description: The current temperature reading in Celsius.

humidity.description: The current humidity reading in percentage.

soundLevel.description: The current sound level reading (raw value).

lightLevel.description: The current light level reading (raw value).

ledStatus.description: The calculated LED status from the device (1:Green, 2:Orange, 3:Red).

definition.description: Stores user profile information. The 'userId' parameter corresponds to the Firebase Authentication UID. It also contains subcollections for user-specific data.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user, matching the Firebase Auth UID.

definition.description: Stores threshold configurations for the user.

params.name: thresholdConfigurationId
params.description: The unique identifier for the threshold configuration.

definition.description: Stores sensor data for the user's device.

params.name: sensorDataId
params.description: The unique identifier for the sensor data document, e.g., 'latest'.

definition.description: Stores the music player state and commands.

params.name: musicControlId
params.description: The unique identifier for the music control document, e.g., 'state'.

definition.description: Used to pair a physical device with a user account. The device creates a document with a token, and the user claims it.

params.name: deviceId
params.description: A unique identifier for the hardware device, such as its MAC address.

firestore.reasoning: Based on the user's request to create an application that allows modifying sensor thresholds and seeing real-time data, the Firestore structure is centered around a 'users' collection. Each user document contains subcollections for 'thresholdConfigurations' and 'sensorData', ensuring data is properly isolated and secured by user. A separate top-level 'devicePairing' collection facilitates linking hardware to user accounts securely. A 'musicControl' subcollection is added to manage playback commands between the app and the device.
